page.layout: One scan showing a closed book in a pale vellum or limp leather binding, seen from the front cover with the spine on the left. No printed text, no title label and no page block is visible. Only stains and spots on the cover.
page.notes: The scan shows the cover of the book, not a printed page. There is no printed text to transcribe. The dark spots and light marks on the vellum are stains and wear, not print. Two ties or thongs are visible at the spine edge.
